responsibility: This file defines and initializes GCC’s global streamer hook table used by generic serialization code. Its sole responsibility is to provide the streamer_hooks object and clear it to a known all-null state so specific streamers such as LTO can install their tree and location read/write callbacks before generic streaming routines invoke them.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/streamer-hooks.h, which defines the streamer_hooks callback interface and convenience macros for generic streaming code, this .cc file only provides the single global streamer_hooks instance and the streamer_hooks_init routine that zero-initializes that table.
